cues: Commands, requests and advice turn the imperative into an infinitive: reporting verb, object, to, base verb.
Stand up: the teacher ordered us to stand up.
Please lend me your pen: he requested me to lend him my pen.
You should see a doctor: she advised me to see a doctor.
A negative takes not to: he warned me not to touch the wires.
And let's becomes suggested: she suggested going for a walk.
